description:
REQUIRES: opi-fin.6.1 (Host behaviour + Stub) merged first.

FILES: Session supervisor/runner (find where OctoPi.Agent.start_session or equivalent is called), api.ex

GOAL: The real Host GenServer is started per session under the session supervisor. bind_core is rewired to delegate to it so zero extension code changes.

STEP 1 -- Create the production Host GenServer:
- New module implementing Host behaviour
- Started as a child of the session supervisor at session startup
- Holds references to: transport layer (for send_message), session state process (for get_active_tools etc.), agent task (for abort)
- Its pid is held by the session runner

STEP 2 -- Wire bind_core to delegate:
In API.bind_core/2 (api.ex), add a new key :host_pid. When present, generate fn-field implementations that delegate to the Host GenServer via the client API functions defined in opi-fin.6.1. Example:
  bind_core(api, %{host_pid: host_pid}) generates:
    send_message: fn msg -> Host.send_message(host_pid, msg) end
    get_active_tools: fn -> Host.get_active_tools(host_pid) end
    ... for all action fields

Existing call sites that pass individual fn values to bind_core continue to work -- the new host_pid key is additive.

VALIDATION: Run full test suite. Zero extension tests should fail (no extension code changes in this ticket). Integration tests should pass with the new supervision structure.
title: 6a: Introduce Host GenServer into session supervision tree
